name: Blood Ritual
source: The client's own text for the ritual switcher and its gear. Rules, stats and rewards are written per season, by hand, when a season has them.
client: Power demands sacrifice. Offer your life essence in the Blood Ritual to gain strength and greater rewards. The more you give, the more you receive. Such rituals are not always performed, so make the most of them while you can.

rules: Trade health for damage, or damage for health: from −20% HP and +24% damage to +20% HP and −22% damage
Loot is a multiplier and only the health-sacrificing side earns it: ×1.25 at −20% HP, ×1.15 at −15%, ×1.1 at −10%, ×1 beyond
Stacks with the Crucible; available until 3 November
seasons.note: Stacks with the Crucible · until 3 November
seasons.source: Season 31 Part 1 patch notes, 2026-10-06 (hub.realmofthemadgod.com/news0/updates0/s31notes1); the end date is that of the Halloween Battle Pass and the Blood Ritual
